volume_basis: county all named candidate votes in declared contest; multiply each county by preference anchor county pair participation
native_mix: 2024 native rows within each county retain their 2024 all-candidate proportions; historical county volume replaces parent only. No cross-year precinct join.

current_opposition_anchors: 2024 Harris/Trump shares and participation transported as explicit hypothetical proxy to each named opposition/Risch pair; two other printed candidates each receive half of residual candidate volume. This split is arbitrary, not inferred.
anchor_observed_county_repeat: additional setting uses each preference anchors own observed county all-candidate volumes
